<main class="layout"><div id="rogContent" class="landingPageLayout"><div class="wrapper"><div><div id="module-system-container" class="modules-content"><div id="moduleArea"><div class="moduleArticleWrapper"><div class="moduleArticleContent"><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>ROG HUB — Trạm Chỉ Huy Của Republic of Gamers</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Chakra+Petch:wght@500;600;700&family=Roboto:wght@400;500;700;800;900&family=Roboto+Mono:wght@400;500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============================================================
   ROG HUB — Design tokens
   Concept: a command console that pulls every ROG signal
   (events, drops, news) into one live feed, tuned for gamer
   energy — HUD chrome, scroll-reactive power bar, rank-up feel.
   Palette: ROG Black 70 / Crystal Lens 18 / Radiant Gold 10 / ROG Red 2
   Fonts: Chakra Petch (HUD/display) + Roboto (body) + Roboto Mono (data/log)
   ============================================================ */
:root{
  --void:#050608;
  --black-1:#0b0c10;
  --black-2:#101216;
  --panel:#131519;
  --panel-2:#181a1f;
  --line:rgba(255,255,255,.07);
  --line-strong:rgba(255,255,255,.14);

  --ink-0:#f3f5f6;
  --ink-1:#989ea2;
  --ink-2:#5c6266;

  --red:#e0233a;
  --red-soft:rgba(224,35,58,.14);
  --red-glow:rgba(224,35,58,.45);

  --crystal:#b9ccd4;
  --crystal-line:#5f7178;
  --crystal-soft:rgba(140,197,214,.14);
  --crystal-glow:rgba(120,200,220,.4);

  --gold:#d9b673;
  --gold-2:#f0d79c;
  --gold-soft:rgba(217,182,115,.16);
  --gold-glow:rgba(217,182,115,.4);

  --font-body:'Roboto',system-ui,sans-serif;
  --font-tech:'Chakra Petch',sans-serif;
  --font-mono:'Roboto Mono',monospace;

  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

*{box-sizing:border-box; margin:0; padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--void);
  color:var(--ink-0);
  font-family:var(--font-body);
  line-height:1.55;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
  overflow-x:hidden;
  position:relative;
}
h1,h2,h3,h4{font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:800;}
a{color:inherit; text-decoration:none;}
img{max-width:100%; display:block;}
.wrap{max-width:1240px; margin:0 auto; padding:0 32px;}
section{position:relative;}
@media (max-width:640px){.wrap{padding:0 20px;}}

/* ---------------- Global background pattern — faint circuit grid, fixed so it drifts under content while scrolling ---------------- */
.bg-fx{
  position:fixed; inset:0; z-index:0; pointer-events:none;
  background-image:
    linear-gradient(var(--line) 1px, transparent 1px),
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line) 1px, transparent 1px);
  background-size:64px 64px;
  opacity:.35;
  -webkit-mask-image:radial-gradient(1200px 800px at 50% 0%, black, transparent 78%);
  mask-image:radial-gradient(1200px 800px at 50% 0%, black, transparent 78%);
}
.bg-fx::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0;
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 42px);
}
header,section,footer{position:relative; z-index:1;}

/* ---------------- Scroll power bar — signature gamer-HUD device ---------------- */
.power-rail{position:fixed; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:3px; z-index:80; background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);}
.power-fill{height:100%; width:0%; background:linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red), var(--gold-2)); box-shadow:0 0 10px 0 var(--red-glow); transition:width .08s linear;}

.eyebrow{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold);}
.eyebrow::before{content:""; width:14px; height:2px; background:var(--gold);}
.section-head{display:flex; align-items:flex-end; justify-content:space-between; margin-bottom:22px; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.section-head h2{font-size:clamp(22px,2.6vw,28px); color:var(--ink-0); margin-top:10px;}
.section-head p.sub{font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; color:var(--ink-1); max-width:520px; margin-top:8px;}
.view-all{font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-1); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line-strong); padding-bottom:3px; transition:.2s var(--ease); white-space:nowrap;}
.view-all:hover{color:var(--gold); border-color:var(--gold);}
.hud-divider{height:1px; background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--line-strong) 0 6px, transparent 6px 12px); opacity:.7; margin-bottom:30px;}

/* ---------------- Corner frame / slash ---------------- */
.corner-frame{position:relative;}
.cf{position:absolute; width:18px; height:18px; pointer-events:none; z-index:3;}
.cf-tl{top:-1px; left:-1px; border-top:2px solid var(--gold); border-left:2px solid var(--gold);}
.cf-tr{top:-1px; right:-1px; border-top:2px solid var(--gold); border-right:2px solid var(--gold);}
.cf-bl{bottom:-1px; left:-1px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold); border-left:2px solid var(--gold);}
.cf-br{bottom:-1px; right:-1px; border-bottom:2px solid var(--gold); border-right:2px solid var(--gold);}
.cf.red{border-color:var(--red);}
.slash{display:inline-flex; gap:3px; width:28px; height:13px;}
.slash span{flex:1; background:var(--red); transform:skewX(-18deg);}

.btn{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:'Chakra Petch','Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif; font-size:13px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:13px 22px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:3px; cursor:pointer; transition:filter .2s ease, background-color .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; white-space:nowrap;}
.btn-primary{background-color:#e0233a; color:#ffffff; border-color:#e0233a;}
.btn-primary:hover{filter:brightness(1.12);}
.btn-ghost{background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.04); color:#f3f5f6; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);}
.btn-ghost:hover{border-color:#5f7178; background-color:rgba(255,255,255,.08);}
.btn-sm{padding:10px 16px; font-size:12px;}

/* ---------------- Trace border ---------------- */
.trace{position:relative;}
.trace::after{
  content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:6;
  background:
    linear-gradient(to right, var(--trace-c, rgba(255,255,255,.4)) 0 100%) top left / 0% 1px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--trace-c, rgba(255,255,255,.4)) 0 100%) top right / 1px 0% no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to left, var(--trace-c, rgba(255,255,255,.4)) 0 100%) bottom right / 0% 1px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to top, var(--trace-c, rgba(255,255,255,.4)) 0 100%) bottom left / 1px 0% no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to right, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) top left / 0 3px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) top left / 3px 0 no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to left, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) top right / 0 3px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) top right / 3px 0 no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to right, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) bottom left / 0 3px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to top, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) bottom left / 3px 0 no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to left, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) bottom right / 0 3px no-repeat,
    linear-gradient(to top, var(--corner-c, var(--gold)) 0 100%) bottom right / 3px 0 no-repeat;
  opacity:0; transition:opacity .2s var(--ease);
}
.trace:hover::after{opacity:1; animation:traceRun .8s var(--ease) forwards;}
@keyframes traceRun{
  0%{background-size:0% 1px, 1px 0%, 0% 1px, 1px 0%, 0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0;}
  50%{background-size:100% 1px, 1px 100%, 0% 1px, 1px 0%, 0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0,0 3px,3px 0;}
  100%{background-size:100% 1px, 1px 100%, 100% 1px, 1px 100%, 14px 3px,3px 14px,14px 3px,3px 14px,14px 3px,3px 14px,14px 3px,3px 14px;}
}

/* ---------------- Scroll reveal ---------------- */
.reveal{opacity:0; transform:translateY(28px); transition:opacity .7s var(--ease), transform .7s var(--ease);}
.reveal.is-in{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0);}
.reveal-stagger.is-in{transition-delay:var(--rd,0ms);}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.reveal{opacity:1; transform:none; transition:none;}}

/* ---------------- Header ---------------- */
.site-head{position:sticky; top:3px; z-index:55;}
header{background:rgba(6,7,9,.92); backdrop-filter:blur(14px) saturate(120%); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.nav{display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; height:72px; gap:24px;}
.logo{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:var(--font-tech); font-weight:700; font-size:16px; letter-spacing:.04em;}
.logo .mark{width:44px; height:44px; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; position:relative;}
.logo .mark svg,.logo .mark img{width:40px; height:40px; object-fit:contain;}
.logo small{display:block; font-family:var(--font-body); font-weight:500; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.12em; color:var(--ink-2); text-transform:none;}
.nav-links{display:flex; gap:30px; font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.03em; text-transform:uppercase;}
.nav-links a{color:var(--ink-1); position:relative; padding:6px 0; transition:color .2s var(--ease); white-space:nowrap;}
.nav-links a:hover{color:var(--ink-0);}
.nav-links a.active{color:var(--ink-0);}
.nav-links a.active::after{content:""; position:absolute; left:0; right:0; bottom:-2px; height:2px; background:var(--red);}
.nav-actions{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;}
.menu-btn{display:none; width:38px; height:38px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); background:var(--black-2); align-items:center; justify-content:center; color:var(--ink-0); cursor:pointer;}
@media (max-width:1080px){.nav-links{display:none;} .menu-btn{display:flex;}}
.mobile-panel{display:none; flex-direction:column; gap:2px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); background:var(--black-2); padding:10px 0;}
.mobile-panel.is-open{display:flex;}
.mobile-panel a{font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:13px; letter-spacing:.05em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--ink-1); padding:12px 4px; border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);}
.mobile-panel a:last-child{border-bottom:none;}

/* ---------------- Hero ---------------- */
.hero{min-height:600px; display:flex; align-items:center; padding:64px 0 76px; overflow:hidden; position:relative;}
.hero-wallpaper{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; background:var(--void);}
.hero-wallpaper img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:right center; display:block;}
.hero-wallpaper::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:
    linear-gradient(90deg, var(--void) 0%, rgba(5,6,8,.92) 32%, rgba(5,6,8,.5) 54%, transparent 76%),
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,6,8,.1) 0%, transparent 26%, rgba(5,6,8,.45) 100%);}
.hero-bgfx{position:absolute; inset:-10% -10% -10% -10%; z-index:0; will-change:transform; pointer-events:none;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 500px at 82% 12%, rgba(224,35,58,.12), transparent 60%),
    radial-gradient(700px 500px at 100% 90%, var(--crystal-soft), transparent 65%);
}
.hero-grid{position:relative; z-index:1; width:100%; pointer-events:none;}
.hero-copy{max-width:620px; text-align:left; pointer-events:auto;}
.hero-copy .eyebrow{margin-bottom:18px;}
.hero h1{font-size:clamp(38px,4.6vw,58px); font-weight:800; line-height:1.08; color:var(--ink-0); margin-bottom:20px;}
.hero h1 .accent{color:var(--gold);}
.hero p.lead{font-size:16px; color:var(--ink-1); max-width:480px; margin-bottom:32px;}
.hero-cta{display:flex; gap:14px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:36px;}

/* ---------------- Signal feed — live console ---------------- */
.signal{background:var(--black-2); border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); padding:0;}
.signal-head{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 0; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--crystal);}
.signal-head .cursor{width:7px; height:14px; background:var(--red); animation:blink 1s step-end infinite;}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0;}}
.signal-track{overflow:hidden; border-top:1px solid var(--line); padding:16px 0; -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, black 6%, black 94%, transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, black 6%, black 94%, transparent);}
.signal-row{display:flex; gap:40px; white-space:nowrap; width:max-content; animation:marquee 34s linear infinite;}
.signal:hover .signal-row{animation-play-state:paused;}
@keyframes marquee{from{transform:translateX(0);} to{transform:translateX(-50%);}}
.sig-item{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font-family:var(--font-mono); font-size:13px; color:var(--ink-1);}
.sig-tag{font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; padding:3px 8px; border-radius:1px;}
.sig-tag.ev{background:var(--red-soft); color:#ff8f9b;}
.sig-tag.dr{background:var(--gold-soft); color:var(--gold-2);}
.sig-tag.nw{background:var(--crystal-soft); color:var(--crystal);}
.sig-tag.co{background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); color:var(--ink-1);}
.sig-item b{color:var(--ink-0); font-weight:500;}

/* ---------------- Event radar grid ---------------- */
.section-events{padding:84px 0 74px;}
.grid-4{display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:20px;}
@media (max-width:1080px){.grid-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);}}
@media (max-width:640px){.grid-4{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.card{position:relative; background:var(--panel); border:1px solid var(--line); overflow:hidden; display:flex; flex-direction:column; transition:transform .35s var(--ease), border-color .35s var(--ease), box-shadow .35s var(--ease);}
.card::before{content:""; position:absolute; top:0; left:0; right:0; height:2px; background:var(--accent-bar, var(--line-strong)); z-index:2;}
.card.card-red{--accent-bar:var(--red); --glow-c:rgba(224,35,58,.4);}
.card.card-crystal{--accent-bar:var(--crystal-line); --glow-c:rgba(140,200,220,.35);}
@property --hue { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: true; initial-value: 42; }
@property --glow-a { syntax: '<number>'; inherits: true; initial-value: 0.05; }
@property --glow-r { syntax: '<length>'; inherits: true; initial-value: 2px; }

.card{
  animation: cardHueSpin 16s linear infinite, cardBreatheRGB 6s ease-in-out infinite;
  box-shadow: 0 0 var(--glow-r) 6px hsla(var(--hue), 75%, 48%, var(--glow-a));
}
.card::before{transition:opacity .4s var(--ease);}

@keyframes cardHueSpin{
  from{ --hue: 42;   }
  to{   --hue: -318; }  /* -318 + 360 = 42 → identical hue, so the loop restart is invisible */
}
@keyframes cardBreatheRGB{
  0%,100%{ --glow-a: 0.05; --glow-r: 2px;  border-color: var(--line); }
  50%{     --glow-a: 0.8;  --glow-r: 24px; border-color: hsl(var(--hue) 75% 48%); }
}

.grid-4 .card:nth-child(1){ animation-delay: 0s, 0s;    }
.grid-4 .card:nth-child(2){ animation-delay: -4s, 1.5s; }
.grid-4 .card:nth-child(3){ animation-delay: -8s, 3s;   }
.grid-4 .card:nth-child(4){ animation-delay: -12s, 4.5s;}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px); border-color:var(--accent-bar, var(--line-strong));}
.card-media{aspect-ratio:16/10; position:relative; overflow:hidden; background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 26px), linear-gradient(150deg, var(--panel-2), var(--black-1));}
.media-img{position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; z-index:1;}
.tag{position:absolute; top:14px; left:14px; z-index:2; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:10px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; padding:6px 10px; backdrop-filter:blur(6px); clip-path:polygon(6px 0,100% 0,100% 100%,0 100%,0 6px);}
.tag-red{background:var(--red-soft); color:#ff9aa2; border:1px solid rgba(224,35,58,.35);}
.tag-crystal{background:var(--crystal-soft); color:var(--crystal); border:1px solid rgba(140,200,220,.3);}
.live-dot{width:5px; height:5px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--red); box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(224,35,58,.6); animation:pulse2 1.6s infinite;}
@keyframes pulse2{0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(224,35,58,.55);} 70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(224,35,58,0);} 100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(224,35,58,0);}}
.card-body{padding:20px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; flex:1;}
.card-body h3{font-size:16px; font-weight:700; color:var(--ink-0);}
.card-meta{display:flex; gap:10px; font-size:12px; color:var(--ink-2); font-weight:500;}
.card-cta{
  margin-top:auto; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;
  font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase;
  color:var(--ink-0); padding:10px 12px; margin-top:14px;
  position:relative; border:none;
  background:var(--line-strong);
  clip-path:polygon(8px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%,0 8px);
  transition:.25s var(--ease);
}
.card-cta::before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute; inset:2px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);
  clip-path:polygon(6px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 6px),calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%,0 6px);
}
.card-cta > *{position:relative; z-index:1;}
.card:hover .card-cta{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg, var(--gold-2), var(--gold));
  color:var(--void);
}
.card:hover .card-cta::before{opacity:0;}
.card:hover .card-cta::before{clip-path:polygon(6px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 6px),calc(100% - 6px) 100%,0 100%,0 6px);}
.card-cta .go{transition:transform .2s var(--ease);}
.card:hover .card-cta .go{transform:translateX(4px);}

 /* ---------------- Game bundle banner ---------------- */
.section-bundle{padding:74px 0;}
.bundle-banner{display:block; position:relative; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--line); background:repeating-linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(255,255,255,.025) 0 1px, transparent 1px 26px), linear-gradient(150deg, var(--panel-2), var(--black-1));}
.bundle-banner picture,
.bundle-banner img{display:block; width:100%; height:100%;}
.bundle-banner img{aspect-ratio:1920/1005; object-fit:cover;}
.bundle-banner:hover{border-color:var(--gold);}
@media (max-width:640px){.bundle-banner img{aspect-ratio:785/466;}}   

/* ---------------- Gamer pride banner ---------------- */
.pride{padding:100px 0; background:var(--black-1); border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); position:relative; overflow:hidden;}
.pride-wallpaper{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; overflow:hidden; background:var(--black-1);}
.pride-wallpaper img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; object-position:center 30%; display:block;}
.pride-wallpaper::after{content:""; position:absolute; inset:0; background:
    linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(5,6,8,.5) 0%, transparent 14%, transparent 82%, rgba(5,6,8,.6) 100%);}
.pride-bgfx{position:absolute; inset:0; z-index:0; background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(224,35,58,.05) 0 2px, transparent 2px 34px); opacity:.7;}
.pride-textzone{position:relative; z-index:1;}
.pride-textzone::before{content:""; position:absolute; z-index:-1; inset:-70px -80px;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 58% at 50% 50%, rgba(5,6,8,.78) 0%, rgba(5,6,8,.6) 38%, rgba(5,6,8,.32) 62%, transparent 88%);
  opacity:0; transition:opacity 1s var(--ease) .1s;}
.pride-textzone:has(.reveal.is-in)::before{opacity:1;}
@supports not selector(:has(*)){
  .pride-textzone::before{opacity:1;}
}
.pride-inner{position:relative; z-index:1; text-align:center; max-width:760px; margin:0 auto;}
.pride .eyebrow{text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.9), 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.9);}
.pride h2{font-size:clamp(28px,4.4vw,46px); line-height:1.15; margin:14px 0 18px; letter-spacing:.01em; text-shadow:0 2px 18px rgba(0,0,0,.9), 0 0 6px rgba(0,0,0,.85);}
.pride h2 .accent{color:var(--red);}
.pride p{font-size:15px; color:var(--ink-0); max-width:560px; margin:0 auto 34px; text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.95), 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.9);}
.pride-chips{display:flex; gap:14px; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap;}
.pride-chip{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-family:var(--font-tech); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.06em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--gold-2); border:1px solid rgba(217,182,115,.5); background:rgba(5,6,8,.55); padding:10px 18px; clip-path:polygon(8px 0,100% 0,100% calc(100% - 8px),calc(100% - 8px) 100%,0 100%,0 8px); backdrop-filter:blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(6px);}
.pride-chip svg{width:15px; height:15px;}
.pride-divider{max-width:420px; margin:40px auto 34px;}
.pride-elite{position:relative; z-index:1; display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:26px;}

<script>
/* Blog filter tabs — actually filters which posts show, and promotes one
   post per tab to the big "feature" slot so every tab keeps the same
   1-big + 4-small layout. */
var FEATURE_BY_TAB = {
  tatca:      'https://rog.asus.com/vn/articles/reviews/danh-gia-rog-strix-scar-18-2026/',
  huongdan:   'https://rog.asus.com/vn/articles/guides/cach-tang-fps-khi-choi-game/',
  danhgia:    'https://rog.asus.com/vn/articles/reviews/danh-gia-rog-strix-scar-18-2026/',
  armoury:    'https://rog.asus.com/vn/articles/rog-gaming-laptops/armoury-crate-la-gi-huong-dan-laptop-gaming-rog/',
  tinsanpham: 'https://rog.asus.com/vn/articles/news/ra-mat-rog-strix-scar-18-2026/'
};
function applyBlogFilter(key){
  document.querySelectorAll('.grid-content .post').forEach(function(post){
    var cats = (post.getAttribute('data-cat') || '').split(' ');
    post.style.display = cats.indexOf(key) !== -1 ? '' : 'none';
    post.classList.toggle('feature', post.getAttribute('href') === FEATURE_BY_TAB[key]);
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill').forEach(function(p){
  p.addEventListener('click', function(){
    document.querySelectorAll('.filter-pill').forEach(function(x){x.classList.remove('is-active');});
    p.classList.add('is-active');
    applyBlogFilter(p.getAttribute('data-filter'));
  });
});
applyBlogFilter('tatca');

/* Nav active state — click sets it immediately, and a scroll-spy keeps it in sync
   with whichever section is actually in view as the user scrolls. */
function setActiveNav(hrefVal){
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a, .mobile-panel a').forEach(function(a){
    a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href') === hrefVal);
  });
}
document.querySelectorAll('.nav-links a, .mobile-panel a').forEach(function(link){
  link.addEventListener('click', function(){
    setActiveNav(link.getAttribute('href'));
  });
});

if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
  var navSections = [
    {href:'#',         el: document.getElementById('home')},
    {href:'#events',   el: document.getElementById('events')},
    {href:'#content',  el: document.getElementById('content')},
    {href:'#products', el: document.getElementById('products')}
  ].filter(function(s){ return s.el; });

  var spyIO = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      if (entry.isIntersecting){
        var match = navSections.filter(function(s){ return s.el === entry.target; })[0];
        if (match) setActiveNav(match.href);
      }
    });
  }, {threshold:0, rootMargin:'-45% 0px -50% 0px'});

  navSections.forEach(function(s){ spyIO.observe(s.el); });
}

var menuBtn = document.getElementById('menuBtn');
var mobilePanel = document.getElementById('mobilePanel');
menuBtn.addEventListener('click', function(){
  var open = mobilePanel.classList.toggle('is-open');
  menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
});
mobilePanel.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){
  a.addEventListener('click', function(){
    mobilePanel.classList.remove('is-open');
    menuBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
  });
});

/* Scroll power bar — fills as the page scrolls */
var powerFill = document.getElementById('powerFill');
function onScroll(){
  var h = document.documentElement;
  var scrollTop = h.scrollTop || document.body.scrollTop;
  var max = (h.scrollHeight || document.body.scrollHeight) - h.clientHeight;
  var pct = max > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.max(0, (scrollTop / max) * 100)) : 0;
  powerFill.style.width = pct + '%';
  if (heroBgfx){ heroBgfx.style.transform = 'translateY(' + (scrollTop * 0.12) + 'px)'; }
}
var heroBgfx = document.getElementById('heroBgfx');
window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, {passive:true});
onScroll();

/* Scroll reveal — sections fade/slide in and out as they enter and leave the viewport, both scrolling down and up */
if ('IntersectionObserver' in window){
  var revealEls = document.querySelectorAll('.reveal');
  var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
    entries.forEach(function(entry){
      entry.target.classList.toggle('is-in', entry.isIntersecting);
    });
  }, {threshold:0.15, rootMargin:'0px 0px -60px 0px'});
  revealEls.forEach(function(el, i){
    el.style.transitionDelay = (Math.min(i % 4, 3) * 70) + 'ms';
    io.observe(el);
  });
} else {
  document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.add('is-in'); });
}
</script>
